//: Each entry removes one behaviour and names the test that must notice. See bench/run-mutations.ts for why these are applied to dist/ and not to src/.

mutations.catches: both onChange handlers run, and the cell is written first
mutations.why: A lost handler is silent: whichever side wins looks correct in the DOM and the other never runs.
A truncated describedby list stops being announced and shows nothing on screen.

mutations.catches: the field wins on identity, whatever the caller asked for
mutations.why: A caller's id silently breaks the label and the error association.

mutations.catches: "touched" keeps a field quiet until its own first blur
mutations.why: The gate opening early is the defect the option exists to prevent.

mutations.catches: a refused submit reveals every field, whatever it asked for
mutations.why: Pressing the button and being told nothing is the one outcome no policy may produce.

mutations.catches: an empty sentence keeps the validator's rather than blanking the error
mutations.why: A blank message under aria-invalid is a field marked wrong with nothing to read.

mutations.catches: a function that rewords nothing hands back the very same array
mutations.why: A fresh array every render wakes every dependency array watching the issues.

mutations.catches: under blur, fixing the field that complained clears it without a blur
mutations.why: A complaint outliving the value it was about argues with a reader who already did what it asked.

mutations.catches: the ancestor clause: a keystroke below a complaint asks for the pass
mutations.why: An edit inside a row has to clear a verdict about the row.

mutations.catches: a field asked for and never drawn is reported apart from one nobody asked for
mutations.why: Everything wired and the page blank is the case the two reasons exist to tell apart.

mutations.catches: a subtree switched off is not missing
mutations.why: A report that names deliberately dormant fields is one that gets switched off.
A server's complaint that no edit can clear is one a reader cannot get past.
An adopted issue that is shown but not counted is a form that displays "declined" and submits anyway.
